title: potentilla nivea var. altaica
intro: Potentilla nivea var. altaica, commonly known as the Snow Cinquefoil or White Cinquefoil, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower inflammation, reduce fever, and treat digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla nivea var. altaica include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
